name: WF-311 — Portfolio Performance → Underwriting Calibration & Dynamic MAO Feedback

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const deal=input.deal??input; const performance=input.portfolio_performance??deal.portfolio_performance??{}; const feedback=input.underwriting_feedback??deal.underwriting_feedback??{}; const sampleSize=Number(deal.historical_sample_size??performance.historical_sample_size??input.historical_sample_size??0); const actualNet=Number(performance.net_profit??deal.net_profit??0); const actualMargin=Number(performance.profit_margin??deal.profit_margin??0); const avgNet=Number(deal.historical_avg_net_profit??input.historical_avg_net_profit??0); const avgMargin=Number(deal.historical_avg_profit_margin??input.historical_avg_profit_margin??0); const dealType=String(performance.deal_type??deal.deal_type??'wholesale').toLowerCase(); const assetType=String(performance.asset_type??deal.asset_type??deal.property_type??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const blockers=Array.isArray(deal.blockers)?deal.blockers:[]; const identityReady=Boolean(deal.deal_id??deal.id); const netDelta=avgNet!==0?(actualNet-avgNet)/Math.abs(avgNet):0; const marginDelta=avgMargin!==0?actualMargin-avgMargin:0; let confidence='low',factor=1.0,reason='insufficient historical sample'; if(sampleSize>=20){confidence='high';if(netDelta<0||marginDelta<-0.10){factor=0.95;reason='high-confidence underperformance';}else if(netDelta>0&&marginDelta>0.10){factor=1.03;reason='high-confidence outperformance';}}else if(sampleSize>=10){confidence='medium';if(marginDelta<-0.15){factor=0.97;reason='medium-confidence margin underperformance';}else if(netDelta>0&&marginDelta>0.15){factor=1.02;reason='medium-confidence outperformance';}} const status=blockers.length?'blocked':!identityReady?'incomplete':!Number.isFinite(actualNet)||!Number.isFinite(actualMargin)?'invalid_performance_inputs':confidence==='low'?'human_review_required':'calibration_ready'; const calibration={sample_size:sampleSize,confidence,net_profit_delta:netDelta,margin_delta:marginDelta,adjustment_factor:factor,reason,asset_type:assetType,deal_type:dealType,ma_rule:'secondary_reference_only',strategy:'asset_specific_economics_first'}; return [{json:{...deal,workflow_id:'WF-311',workflow_name:'Portfolio Performance → Underwriting Calibration & Dynamic MAO Feedback',status,calibration,underwriting_feedback:feedback,next_workflow:status==='calibration_ready'?'WF-312':status==='human_review_required'?'WF-126':status==='blocked'?'WF-126':'WF-310',crm_activity:{activity_type:'underwriting_calibration',deal_id:deal.deal_id??deal.id,status,calibration}}}];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { workflow_id: $json.workflow_id, status: $json.status, next_workflow: $json.next_workflow, calibration: $json.calibration, crm_persisted: true } }}

meta.description: Uses confidence-weighted realized performance to calibrate future underwriting and dynamic MAO; 70% rule remains secondary reference only.
